create.name: Lisa Powers
create.bio:
Lisa Powers has quietly taught more people reiki than almost anyone alive. A Reiki Master and Teacher with a Bachelor of Kinesiology and a Bachelor of Education, she brought a rare combination to energy healing when she began teaching online twenty-three years ago: a scientist’s understanding of the body, an educator’s gift for structure, and a healer’s heart. The result became one of the most trusted pathways into reiki in the world — more than 245,000 students across every continent, 77,000 reviews averaging 4.8 stars, and a generation of practitioners who took their first attunement with her calm, grounding voice in their ears.

Her teaching spans the complete journey: Usui Reiki from Level I through Master/Teacher certification, and beyond into specialisations that have become classics in their own right — Animal Reiki for healing work with creatures of every size, Crystal Reiki weaving earth energy and sacred geometry into practice, and even a reiki business course for healers ready to serve professionally. As Director of the International Reiki Organization, she has helped shape the standards of the modern profession itself. Students consistently describe the same experience: teaching that feels both grounding and deeply spiritual, easy to follow yet faithful to the depth of the practice — the voice of a teacher who believes healing belongs in everyone’s hands.

books.title: Reiki Level I, II & Master Manual
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: The complete companion to traditional Usui Reiki, from your first self-treatment through to Master level. Lisa brings years of teaching experience to clear, step-by-step guidance for practising on yourself and others. It suits newcomers and experienced students who want to review and deepen their practice.

books.title: Crystal Reiki Manual
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: This manual combines the earth energy of crystals with universal life force energy. It shows how to choose, cleanse and charge stones, build crystal grids and give full Crystal Reiki sessions. It is written for beginners and Reiki Masters alike, and includes a curriculum for teaching the practice.

books.title: Somatic Therapy Toolkit: Fast, Effective Exercises for Trauma Recovery and Lasting Emotional Wellness
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: A practical guide to releasing stress and unresolved trauma through the body. It offers simple somatic exercises grounded in current research and shows how to build them into a daily practice. It is written for people healing themselves and for the practitioners who support them.

books.title: The Shadow Work Journey: Complete Guide with Journal Prompts, Workbook Exercises and Step-by-Step Tools to Heal Your Inner Child, Build Self-Acceptance, and Create Emotional Freedom
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: A guide to meeting the hidden parts of yourself with compassion rather than fear. Journal prompts, workbook exercises and mindful practices help you spot limiting beliefs, release emotional blocks and heal your inner child. It is written for anyone ready for deep, lasting change.

books.title: 369 Manifesting Method Journal: Discover the Divine Code to Manifest Your Dream Life
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: A structured daily journal built around the 3-6-9 method: write your intention three times in the morning, six in the afternoon and nine in the evening. Intention pages, weekly reflections, visualisations, affirmations and gratitude logs help keep your focus steady. It is a few minutes a day spent working towards abundance, love or clarity.

books.title: Animals & Mindfulness Coloring for Adults: 60 Intricate Animal Patterns for Stress Relief, and Relaxation
books.author: Lisa Powers
books.description: A calming colouring book of intricate animal mandalas, each paired with a mindfulness affirmation. It works as a creative meditation that eases stress, sharpens focus and brings you back to yourself. It suits every skill level.

courses.title: Reiki Level I, II and Master/Teacher Certification
courses.description: Her main course: traditional Usui Reiki from Level I through Master/Teacher. It includes video lessons, sample sessions, a 250-page manual, attunements for all three levels and three certificates. Students learn to treat themselves and others, send distance Reiki and attune their own students.

courses.title: Animal Reiki Practitioner Certification
courses.description: Learn to give hands-on and distance Reiki to animals of every size, from pets to wildlife. The course covers Reiki symbols, creating a healing space, working with an animal's energy centres and communicating intuitively with animals. Attunements are included, and it suits beginners and experienced practitioners.

courses.title: Crystal Reiki Master/Teacher Certification
courses.description: Combine crystals with Reiki to tailor sessions to each person's intentions. You'll learn how to choose, cleanse and programme crystals, use eight sacred Crystal Reiki symbols, build grids and give attunements. It is for students who already have Reiki Level I and II, and includes an 85-page manual.

courses.title: Build Your Ideal Reiki Business
courses.description: A step-by-step plan for turning a Reiki calling into a professional practice, online or in person. It covers finding ideal clients, money blocks, licensing and insurance, intake forms, scheduling and outreach. Editable brochures, forms, manuals and certificate templates are included.

courses.title: Meditation with Mudras, Sound & Sacred Breath
courses.description: Build a meditation practice around your own needs using mudras (sacred hand gestures), sound and breath. It is a gentle, practical introduction to these traditional tools for calm and focus.

courses.title: Crystal Reiki Master, Animal Reiki, Reiki Business Course Bundle
courses.description: Her three specialist trainings in one package: Crystal Reiki Master/Teacher, Animal Reiki Practitioner and the Reiki Business course, with manuals, certificates and lifetime access. Good value for practitioners ready to specialise and go professional.

free_resources.title: Energetic Cord Cutting: What It Is, How to Do It, and Why It Matters
free_resources.description: A complete six-step cord-cutting ritual for releasing draining attachments and taking back your energy. It moves from setting an intention and visualising the cords to cutting them, releasing them with forgiveness and grounding in protective light.

free_resources.title: How to Start Shadow Work: A Step-by-Step Guide to Self-Discovery and Healing
free_resources.description: An eight-step practice for beginning shadow work safely and kindly. It covers preparing your mindset, creating a safe space, shadow journaling, meditation, dream journaling, creative expression and integration.
